findings: The private coordinate calculation reindexes both the replica sum and its product factors by the inverse copy permutation. Invariant entries give commutation with the existing inverse-oriented permOp.
The literal constant tensor product has invariant entries by the same finite-product reindexing. The matrix can be arbitrary: no PSD, trace, Hermiticity or invariance certificate is assumed.

The actual replicaDefectCount is definitionally replicaHamiltonian(1-ΩΩᴴ). Existing Commute.cfc_real transfers actual commutation to every real function, including the closed characteristic-function cutoff; no global indicator continuity is imposed.
Literal Kronecker multiplication shows that the physical function tensored with auxiliary identity commutes with Uσ⊗M for every auxiliary matrix M. This includes simultaneous auxiliary copy actions.

The vector-preservation result follows from operator commutation and its fixed-vector assumption. Setting σ=1 and taking actual auxiliary Schur projectors gives preservation of fixed sectors, without assuming cutoff invariance.
Zero copies are included; no nonempty-copy index is introduced. No Ω or vector normalization is needed for the commutation or preservation results.
Gap, mass, ground-factor decomposition, iid concentration and entropy-window selection remain separate results. No desired estimate or desired cutoff invariance is supplied as a hypothesis.
